title: Charge for Drawing a Transferee's Certificate of Retained Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
Where the class issues a written certificate for retained equity, the transferee's certificate must be drawn afresh from the whole history, and the charge for drawing it follows how long that history is.

| What the class and the equity ledger carry | Certificate charge |
| --- | --- |
| the class issues a written certificate for retained equity, and 10 or more capital retain lines stand on the equity ledger | 15.00 |
| the class issues a written certificate for retained equity, and fewer than 10 capital retain lines stand on the equity ledger | 5.00 |
| the class issues no certificate | no certificate charge is made |

**On the count.** What is counted is the capital retain lines standing on the membership's equity ledger, however many fiscal years they fall across. At 10 such lines the first row is reached; at 9 it is not, and the charge is 5.00.

**On the class.** Whether a class of Membership and Patronage Equity issues a written certificate for retained equity at all is what the class schedule records against it. Where it issues none, the count of retain lines does not come into it.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical records

| Class issues a written certificate | Capital retain lines standing | Certificate charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 14 | 15.00 |
| yes | 10 | 15.00 |
| yes | 9 | 5.00 |
| yes | none | 5.00 |
| no | 14 | none |
